name: detectability_pilot_v1
description: 30-case pilot fixture for scoring the DetectabilityClassifier; 6 cases per class. Labels owner-adjudicated 2026-06-13 — all 30 draft labels accepted as drafted.

cve.title: Apache Log4j2 JNDI RCE (Log4Shell)
cve.description: Log4j2 JNDI lookup allows attacker-controlled LDAP/RMI URLs in logged strings to load and execute remote code on the JVM host.

trigger_conditions: attacker-controlled string reaches a logging call

network.value: outbound LDAP/RMI from a JVM process to external host on port 389 or 1099
subsequent HTTP fetch of a remote Java class file from attacker-controlled host

process.value: java process spawning a shell child (sh, bash, cmd, powershell)

command_line.value: ${jndi:ldap://...} pattern appearing in HTTP request headers or POST body fields

expected.notes: Strong stable network egress + java->shell child process + ${jndi:} payload signature; high-fidelity in standard telemetry.

cve.title: GNU Bash Shellshock Remote Code Execution
cve.description: Bash incorrectly processes trailing strings after function definitions in environment variables, allowing remote code execution via crafted HTTP headers in CGI scripts.

trigger_conditions: HTTP server passes environment variables to Bash-based CGI handler

process.value: httpd or apache2 spawning bash child that spawns curl, wget, or nc

command_line.value: () { :;}; pattern in HTTP User-Agent, Referer, or Cookie headers
outbound network utility (curl/wget/nc) executed from web server child process

network.value: outbound connection to external host initiated by web server process

parent_child.value: httpd -> bash -> curl/wget/nc process lineage visible in audit logs

expected.notes: httpd->bash->shell_child parent chain + () {:}; header signature are stable and high-fidelity in web server logs and auditd.

cve.title: Microsoft Outlook NTLM Credential Leak via UNC Path
cve.description: Outlook processes a crafted calendar reminder with a UNC path in the sound file field, triggering an automatic NTLM authentication to an attacker-controlled SMB server and leaking the user's Net-NTLMv2 hash.

trigger_conditions: victim receives a specially crafted meeting invite; no user interaction required

network.value: outlook.exe initiating SMB connection (port 445) to a non-internal/non-fileserver IP
NTLM Type-1/Type-3 authentication traffic to external SMB host

process.value: outlook.exe making direct outbound network connection without browser/proxy intermediary

command_line.value: UNC path (\\external-ip\share) present in calendar item sound file field

expected.notes: outlook.exe -> anomalous SMB egress to non-fileserver is a stable, unique signal detectable with standard Windows network telemetry.

cve.title: Windows Print Spooler RCE (PrintNightmare)
cve.description: Windows Print Spooler service allows authenticated remote users to install printer drivers, which executes arbitrary DLLs with SYSTEM privileges via the AddPrinterDriverEx() RPC call.

trigger_conditions: attacker has network access and any domain credential

process.value: spoolsv.exe loading a DLL from a UNC path (\\attacker\share\evil.dll)
spoolsv.exe spawning a child process (cmd, powershell, mshta)

file.value: malicious DLL written to C:\Windows\System32\spool\drivers\x64\3\ directory

network.value: spoolsv.exe making SMB connection (port 445) to external or unexpected host to fetch driver DLL

api_call.value: AddPrinterDriverEx RPC call with DRIVER_INFO_2 pointing to remote UNC path

expected.notes: spoolsv.exe DLL load from UNC + driver write to spool directory + RPC call pattern is a high-fidelity, well-documented detection. [Adjudicated 2026-06-14: reclassified indirectly_detectable — the reliable signal is the spoolsv child / DLL-load consequence, not the RPC exploit itself.]

cve.title: Netlogon Elevation of Privilege (Zerologon)
cve.description: A cryptographic flaw in Microsoft's Netlogon Remote Protocol allows an unauthenticated attacker on the network to reset a domain controller's machine account password, leading to domain compromise.

trigger_conditions: attacker has network connectivity to a domain controller on port 445/139

network.value: burst of Netlogon RPC (MS-NRPC) authentication attempts with zeroed client challenge bytes from a single source

api_call.value: NetrServerAuthenticate3 calls with all-zero ClientCredential field
NetrServerPasswordSet2 call immediately after successful authentication (credential reset)

process.value: lsass.exe handling excessive Netlogon secure channel setup requests from one IP in short timeframe

expected.notes: Zero-filled Netlogon credential + burst pattern + password-reset RPC is a unique, published detection with Windows Security Event ID 4742 correlation.

cve.title: EternalBlue SMBv1 Remote Code Execution
cve.description: A buffer overflow in the Windows SMB Server allows remote code execution via a specially crafted SMBv1 packet, exploited by WannaCry and NotPetya ransomware campaigns.

trigger_conditions: SMBv1 enabled and reachable; no authentication required

network.value: malformed SMBv1 TRANS2 request with oversized ParameterCount field inbound on port 445
lateral movement to port 445 across subnet following initial compromise

process.value: svchost.exe (LanmanServer) spawning unexpected child process post-exploit

api_call.value: kernel-level shellcode execution via pool corruption triggering abnormal syscall sequence in srv.sys

expected.notes: Malformed SMBv1 packet + svchost anomalous child + lateral port-445 scanning provides rich, well-characterized network and host signal.

cve.title: Microsoft Exchange ProxyLogon SSRF
cve.description: A server-side request forgery vulnerability in Exchange's Autodiscover endpoint allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass authentication and write arbitrary files, commonly used to drop webshells.

trigger_conditions: Exchange server reachable over HTTPS; no authentication required

file.value: ASPX webshell written under C:\inetpub\wwwroot\aspnet_client\ or Exchange OWA directory
new file with .aspx extension created in Exchange backend inetpub directories

process.value: w3wp.exe spawning cmd.exe or powershell.exe after webshell interaction

network.value: incoming POST to /autodiscover/autodiscover.json with X-BEResource header containing internal Exchange path

unanswered_questions: Does telemetry capture file creation in IIS virtual directories?

expected.notes: The exploit itself is quiet; detection relies on post-exploit artifact (webshell file write + w3wp child) rather than the SSRF mechanism itself.

cve.title: Citrix ADC / NetScaler Path Traversal RCE
cve.description: A path traversal vulnerability in Citrix ADC and NetScaler Gateway allows unauthenticated remote code execution via a crafted HTTP request that writes a Perl script to the /netscaler/portal/scripts directory.

vuln_profile.affected_component: Citrix ADC management interface (nsppe / nsvpn daemon)
trigger_conditions: Citrix ADC management port or VPN endpoint accessible without authentication

file.value: Perl template or script file created in /netscaler/portal/scripts/ directory by web daemon process

process.value: nsppe or nsvpn process spawning /usr/bin/perl with the attacker-written script

network.value: HTTP request containing ../ traversal in URL path targeting /vpn/../vpns/cfg/smb.conf or similar

unanswered_questions: Are file-system audit events available on the Citrix ADC appliance?

expected.notes: Detection relies on Perl template write artifact and process spawn; the traversal payload is detectable in HTTP logs but file audit on appliances is often absent.

cve.title: Fortinet FortiOS SSL VPN Credential File Path Traversal
cve.description: An improper limitation of pathname in the FortiOS SSL VPN web portal allows unauthenticated attackers to read the sslvpn_websession file containing cleartext credentials via a crafted HTTP request.

vuln_profile.affected_component: FortiOS SSL VPN web portal file serving logic
trigger_conditions: FortiGate SSL VPN portal accessible from the internet without authentication

network.value: HTTP GET request to /remote/fgt_lang?lang=/../../../../../../../etc/passwd or sslvpn_websession path
200 OK response to traversal request returning file content from sslvpn_websession

file.value: access to /var/opt/sslvpn/websession or equivalent credential cache file by unauthenticated HTTP session

unanswered_questions: Does the FortiOS deployment log file reads from the VPN session store?

expected.notes: Traversal request visible in HTTP access logs; direct credential file access depends on appliance-level file audit which is often disabled by default. [Adjudicated 2026-06-14: reclassified directly_detectable — the /../ traversal URI is itself a high-fidelity, matchable signature in HTTP access logs.]

cve.title: F5 BIG-IP iControl REST Authentication Bypass RCE
cve.description: An authentication bypass in F5 BIG-IP iControl REST API allows unauthenticated remote code execution by sending crafted HTTP requests with a spoofed X-F5-Auth-Token header.

vuln_profile.affected_component: F5 BIG-IP iControl REST API management interface
trigger_conditions: BIG-IP management port (443/8443) accessible from attacker network

command_line.value: bash or sh process spawned by the httpd/icontrol REST API server process with attacker-supplied command

process.value: httpd (the iControl mgmt server) spawning bash/sh children executing system commands

network.value: POST request to /mgmt/tm/util/bash with X-F5-Auth-Token: localhost header from external source

expected.notes: The bash command execution is detectable; the auth bypass header is subtle and only clearly observable in HTTP logs with full header capture enabled.

cve.title: VMware vCenter Server File Upload RCE
cve.description: An unauthenticated file upload vulnerability in the vCenter Server vSphere HTML5 client (vRealize Operations plugin endpoint) allows remote code execution by uploading a JSP webshell.

vuln_profile.affected_component: VMware vCenter vRealize Operations plugin endpoint (/ui/vropspluginui/rest/services/uploadova)
trigger_conditions: vCenter Server HTTPS port accessible without authentication

file.value: JSP or WAR file written to vCenter web application directory by tomcat process
New .jsp file under /usr/lib/vmware-vsphere-ui/server/work/ or similar vCenter webroot

process.value: vsphere-ui or tomcat process spawning a shell (bash/sh) child after webshell access

network.value: Unauthenticated POST multipart upload to /ui/vropspluginui/rest/services/uploadova endpoint

expected.notes: Detection is post-exploit (webshell file write + tomcat child spawn) rather than the upload itself; requires file integrity monitoring on vCenter webroot directories.

cve.title: Windows Remote Desktop Services Pre-Authentication RCE (BlueKeep)
cve.description: A use-after-free in Windows Remote Desktop Services allows unauthenticated remote code execution via a specially crafted RDP connection, exploitable before any credentials are checked.

vuln_profile.affected_component: Windows Remote Desktop Services (termdd.sys) Channel 3 handler
trigger_conditions: RDP port 3389 reachable; no authentication required; Windows 7/Server 2008 R2 or older

network.value: anomalous RDP channel negotiation packets with malformed MS_T120 channel data before authentication
connection terminated abruptly or kernel crash (Blue Screen) following crafted RDP request

process.value: svchost.exe (termservice) spawning unexpected child process after successful exploitation

unanswered_questions: Is kernel-level RDP protocol anomaly detection available in this environment?

expected.notes: Only 2 categories filled; exploit-layer RDP anomaly is hard to distinguish from legitimate errors; detection relies on post-exploit process behavior which is secondary.

cve.title: Windows CryptoAPI Certificate Validation Spoofing (CurveBall)
cve.description: Windows CryptoAPI (crypt32.dll) fails to validate the parameters of elliptic curve keys in certificates, allowing an attacker to spoof code signatures and TLS certificates using a crafted certificate chain.

trigger_conditions: victim processes an attacker-presented certificate with crafted ECC key parameters

api_call.value: CertVerifyCertificateChainPolicy invoked with certificate containing spoofed ECC curve parameters (detectable only with CryptoAPI audit logging enabled)

unanswered_questions: Is Windows CryptoAPI audit event logging (Event ID 80/81) enabled?
Does the environment log certificate validation failures?

expected.notes: Requires CryptoAPI audit logging (usually off by default); no host signal without that telemetry; runtime detection depends entirely on operator logging policy.

cve.title: Polkit pkexec Local Privilege Escalation (PwnKit)
cve.description: A memory corruption vulnerability in pkexec (Polkit's SUID binary) allows any unprivileged local user to gain root privileges by exploiting a flaw in the argument vector handling.

trigger_conditions: local user account access; pkexec SUID binary present (default on most Linux distributions)

process.value: pkexec executed by a non-root user immediately followed by a root-owned shell spawn (requires auditd execve syscall rules)

api_call.value: execve() syscall on pkexec binary with crafted argc=0 (detectable via Linux auditd execve audit rules)

unanswered_questions: Are Linux auditd execve rules enabled for SUID binaries?
Is eBPF-based process monitoring deployed?

expected.notes: Detectable via Linux auditd execve rules on SUID binaries; most Linux deployments do NOT enable these rules by default, so detection is environment-dependent.

cve.title: Linux Kernel Dirty COW Race Condition Privilege Escalation
cve.description: A race condition in the Linux kernel's memory subsystem (mm/gup.c) allows local users to gain write access to read-only memory mappings, enabling privilege escalation by overwriting SUID binaries or /etc/passwd.

trigger_conditions: local user account; Linux kernel version 2.6.22 to 4.8.2

file.value: write to /proc/self/mem or /proc/<pid>/mem targeting a read-only memory-mapped region (detectable with auditd file watches on /proc)

api_call.value: mmap() + madvise(MADV_DONTNEED) + write() syscall sequence on read-only file-backed mapping in rapid succession (requires auditd syscall tracing)

unanswered_questions: Is auditd configured to watch /proc filesystem access?
Is kernel syscall tracing (BPF/eBPF) deployed?

expected.notes: Detectable only with /proc filesystem audit watches + syscall-level tracing; rarely configured in standard Linux deployments without explicit security hardening.

cve.title: Sudo Heap Buffer Overflow (Baron Samedit)
cve.description: A heap overflow in sudo's command parsing (sudoers policy plugin) when invoked with a backslash-terminated argument allows any local user to gain root privileges without password.

trigger_conditions: local user account; sudo version 1.8.2 to 1.9.5p1 installed

process.value: sudoedit invoked with malformed argument list containing trailing backslash by non-sudo-authorized user (detectable with auditd execve on /usr/bin/sudoedit)

command_line.value: sudoedit or sudo -s -i invoked with a command line ending in a single backslash character

unanswered_questions: Is auditd logging sudo/sudoedit execve events?
Is sudo audit logging enabled in sudoers?

expected.notes: Detection requires auditd sudo execve logging or sudo audit plugin; neither is default; environment with explicit sudo audit config can catch the malformed invocation.

cve.title: Linux Kernel Dirty Pipe File Overwrite Privilege Escalation
cve.description: A flaw in the Linux kernel pipe handling (PIPE_BUF_FLAG_CAN_MERGE) allows local users to overwrite data in arbitrary read-only files including SUID binaries, enabling privilege escalation.

vuln_profile.affected_component: Linux kernel pipe page cache merge (fs/pipe.c)
trigger_conditions: local user account; Linux kernel 5.8 to 5.16.10

file.value: unexpected write to a read-only file or SUID binary such as /usr/bin/passwd detected via file integrity monitoring (FIM)

api_call.value: splice() followed by write() to a pipe with PIPE_BUF_FLAG_CAN_MERGE targeting a read-only page cache entry (detectable via eBPF/auditd syscall tracing)

unanswered_questions: Is file integrity monitoring (FIM/auditd inotify) deployed on SUID binaries?
Are kernel-level pipe syscalls being traced?

expected.notes: Detectable only with FIM on SUID binaries or kernel syscall tracing; standard Linux setups lack both; high EPSS/exploitation frequency makes investment justified.

cve.title: Windows Print Spooler Remote Code Execution (Early PrintNightmare Variant)
cve.description: An earlier Print Spooler vulnerability allows low-privileged users to load arbitrary DLLs via the AddPrinter API, requiring Sysmon Event ID 7 (image load) telemetry for detection of the DLL loading behavior.

trigger_conditions: low-privileged Windows user account; Print Spooler service running

file.value: malicious DLL written to print driver directory C:\Windows\System32\spool\drivers\

api_call.value: spoolsv.exe loading an unsigned or unusual DLL via AddPrinterDriverEx (visible in Sysmon Event ID 7 image load events if Sysmon is deployed with ImageLoad monitoring)

unanswered_questions: Is Sysmon deployed with Event ID 7 image load rules enabled?
Is Windows Defender Application Control (WDAC) blocking unsigned DLL loads?

expected.notes: DLL image-load detection requires Sysmon EID 7 with image load rules, which is not enabled in default Sysmon configurations; file write to spool directory is a secondary signal.

cve.title: OpenSSL X.400 Address Type Confusion (GeneralName)
cve.description: A type confusion vulnerability in OpenSSL's X.509 certificate parsing of X.400 addresses (GeneralName ASN.1 structure) can lead to a read of a memory address, potentially enabling denial of service or information disclosure.

vuln_profile.affected_component: OpenSSL X.509 GeneralName X.400 address parsing (x509v3.c)
trigger_conditions: application uses CRL Distribution Points or OCSP with X.400 addresses; attacker can present a crafted certificate

unanswered_questions: What runtime telemetry is available for OpenSSL memory operations?
Can TLS session metadata identify certificates with X.400 GeneralName fields?

expected.notes: No observable runtime host signal; exploitation occurs inside TLS certificate parsing with no external process or network artifact; mitigation (patch/upgrade) is the only defense.

cve.title: OpenSSL Punycode Buffer Overflow in X.509 Certificate Email Field
cve.description: A buffer overflow in OpenSSL's punycode decoding of email address fields in X.509 certificates (emailAddress Subject Alternative Name) can cause a stack buffer overflow and crash or potential code execution.

vuln_profile.affected_component: OpenSSL punycode decoding for X.509 emailAddress SAN (crypto/punycode.c)
trigger_conditions: application verifies a TLS certificate from an attacker-controlled CA containing a crafted punycode email SAN

unanswered_questions: Is there any telemetry for TLS certificate parsing failures at the library level?
Can process crash or core dump analysis reveal exploitation attempts?

expected.notes: Stack overflow in certificate email parsing occurs inside the TLS handshake; no host telemetry can observe this without library instrumentation; patch is the only mitigation.

cve.title: OpenSSL SM2 Decryption Buffer Overflow
cve.description: A buffer overflow in OpenSSL's SM2 decryption implementation allows an attacker who can present a crafted SM2 content to overflow the allocated buffer, potentially executing arbitrary code in applications using SM2 decryption.

trigger_conditions: application calls EVP_PKEY_decrypt with SM2 key; attacker controls decryption input

unanswered_questions: Does the application log SM2 decryption operation metadata?
Is there process memory telemetry that could identify buffer overflow patterns?

expected.notes: SM2 decryption overflow is an in-process cryptographic operation with no observable host signal; SM2 is uncommon in non-Chinese deployments; control is upgrade/disable SM2.

cve.title: OpenSSL Heartbleed TLS Heartbeat Out-of-Bounds Memory Read
cve.description: A missing bounds check in OpenSSL's TLS heartbeat extension allows remote attackers to read up to 64KB of server memory per request, leaking private keys, session tokens, and credentials without authentication.

trigger_conditions: TLS service using OpenSSL 1.0.1 through 1.0.1f reachable; no authentication required

network.value: TLS heartbeat request with length field larger than payload (oversized heartbeat); volume of heartbeat requests from one source may indicate scanning/exploitation

unanswered_questions: Is deep packet inspection of TLS heartbeat messages available?
Can IDS rules detect oversized TLS heartbeat payloads without full TLS decryption?

expected.notes: Memory disclosure leaves no host artifact; network detection requires TLS-aware IDS inspecting heartbeat payload sizes; primary controls are patch + certificate rotation.

cve.title: Google libwebp Heap Buffer Overflow (0-day used in Chrome/Electron)
cve.description: A heap buffer overflow in the libwebp library's BuildHuffmanTable function allows remote code execution when processing a crafted WebP image, exploited as a zero-day in Chromium-based browsers and Electron apps.

trigger_conditions: victim opens or previews a malicious WebP image via a vulnerable browser or application

unanswered_questions: Can renderer process crash telemetry identify WebP-triggered heap corruption?
Are browser process memory analysis tools deployed?

expected.notes: Client-side image parsing in sandboxed renderer; no reliable runtime signal outside of browser telemetry; mitigation is patch + content filtering of WebP in untrusted contexts.

cve.title: Cisco ASA/FTD Web Services Path Traversal (Unauthenticated File Read)
cve.description: A path traversal vulnerability in Cisco ASA and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) web services allows unauthenticated remote attackers to read sensitive files from the file system including configuration data.

vuln_profile.affected_component: Cisco ASA/FTD web services file serving (ASDM/WebVPN)
trigger_conditions: ASA ASDM or WebVPN web portal accessible from attacker network; no authentication

network.value: HTTP GET request with ../ or %2F traversal sequence to /+CSCOT+/translation-table?type=mst&textdomain=...&lang=en target

unanswered_questions: Does the ASA/FTD generate web access logs for management plane HTTP requests?
Are syslog events for management-plane file access available?

expected.notes: Only 1 category filled; HTTP log visibility on ASA is minimal; file read from appliance leaves no additional host artifact; control is patch + restrict management interface access.

cve.title: Unauthenticated RCE in Industrial Appliance X (Details Withheld)
cve.description: A pre-authentication remote code execution vulnerability in a network appliance; technical details are withheld by the vendor pending a coordinated patch. No PoC or detection guidance has been published.

trigger_conditions: unknown

unanswered_questions: What component is vulnerable?
What is the exploitation mechanism?
What host or network artifacts does exploitation produce?

expected.notes: No technical details available; cannot determine detection artifacts; classifier should decline to assign a detection class without more information.

cve.title: Cisco ASA/FTD Persistent Local Code Execution (Sparse Detail)
cve.description: A vulnerability in Cisco ASA and FTD allows an authenticated attacker with low privileges to execute code persistently on the device. Limited public technical details are available describing only a vague process-level indicator.

trigger_conditions: unknown authentication requirement

process.value: anomalous process execution on Cisco ASA device (sparse vendor advisory only)

unanswered_questions: What specific process executes?
What network or file artifacts accompany exploitation?
What are the exact trigger conditions?

expected.notes: Only 1 vague indicator category; insufficient specificity to write a detection; more detail needed on trigger conditions, process identity, and correlated artifacts.

cve.title: Reserved CVE — Details Embargoed
cve.description: This CVE identifier has been reserved but the details are under embargo. No public technical information is available at the time of this assessment.

trigger_conditions: unknown

unanswered_questions: What product and component is affected?
What is the vulnerability class?
Are any IOCs or behavioral indicators available under NDA?

expected.notes: CVE is embargoed; no technical detail available; classification is impossible without minimum information about the vulnerability or its exploitation artifacts.

cve.title: Contradictory/Placeholder Assessment (Synthetic Case)
cve.description: A synthetic case representing contradictory or placeholder indicator data where initial source material contains mutually inconsistent claims about exploitation behavior, precluding reliable detection guidance.

trigger_conditions: unknown

unanswered_questions: Source A claims network-only exploitation; Source B claims no network egress occurs. Which is correct?
Reported behavior in Source C contradicts Sources A and B. Assessment quality insufficient.

expected.notes: Contradictory indicators from sources prevent reliable classification; analyst should re-run Loop 2 with curated, consistent source material before attempting detection.

cve.title: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Attack (Denial of Service)
cve.description: A protocol-level flaw in HTTP/2 allows an attacker to send a large number of HEADERS frames immediately followed by RST_STREAM frames, exhausting server resources and causing denial of service without completing any request.

vuln_profile.affected_component: HTTP/2 server stream handling (all major web servers and frameworks)
trigger_conditions: HTTP/2 endpoint accessible; attacker sends rapid HEADERS+RST_STREAM cycles

network.value: high volume of HTTP/2 RST_STREAM frames following HEADERS frames from single source; server resource exhaustion metrics spiking

unanswered_questions: What host artifacts (beyond network-layer rate counters) distinguish this from legitimate high-traffic?
Is there a process-level indicator for HTTP/2 stream exhaustion?

expected.notes: Availability-only DoS; only 1 category filled; the network signal is rate-based and hard to distinguish from legitimate traffic spikes; no host artifact; detection guidance is underspecified. [Adjudicated 2026-06-14: reclassified environment_dependent — a rate-based signal does exist; it requires special rate-monitoring telemetry rather than being unclassifiable.]

cve.title: Vendor-Confirmed Vulnerability — No Public Technical Detail
cve.description: A vendor has confirmed a vulnerability in their product and released a patch, but has not disclosed any technical details about the vulnerability class, affected component, or potential exploitation behavior.

trigger_conditions: unknown

unanswered_questions: No public information about exploitation behavior is available.
Vendor advisory contains only CVSS score and patch instructions.
No researcher analysis, PoC, or incident reports exist at time of assessment.

expected.notes: Vendor patch-only advisory with no technical disclosure; Loop 2 produced zero indicators; classification deferred until exploit research or incident data becomes available.
